Title: Some users may encounter refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI

User impact: Users may encounter refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Current status: We're analyzing service telemetry to help us identify the root cause and the next steps required to mitigate impact.

Scope of impact: Impact may be specific to some users expecting refreshes using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Title: Some users may encounter refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI

User impact: Users may encounter refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Current status: We've identified that a regression in the Dynamics 365 Business Central control plane is causing API connection failures. We're rolling back the affected service to remediate the issue and are monitoring progress.

Scope of impact: Impact may be specific to some users expecting refreshes using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Root cause: A regression in the Dynamics 365 Business Central control-plane service is causing refresh failures when using the connector in Power BI

Next update by: Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may encounter refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI

User impact: Users may have encountered refresh failures when using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Final status: After our completed rollback of the affected service, our internal telemetry verified that the impact had been remediated.

Scope of impact: The impact was specific to some users who had expected refreshes using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector in Power BI.

Start time: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 3:00 PM UTC

End time: Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 2:32 PM UTC

Root cause: A regression in the Dynamics 365 Business Central control-plane service was causing refresh failures when using the connector in Power BI

Next steps: 
- We're further analyzing the regression to help us isolate its source, and to help prevent similar issues in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
